name: Nakanobu
tagline: Two covered shopping streets, 16 minutes to Shinagawa.
summary: Nakanobu sits on both the Tokyu Oimachi Line and the Toei Asakusa Line, putting Shinagawa 16 minutes away and most central hubs within about 30 minutes. Two arcade shopping streets — Nakanobu and Togoshi-Ginza — are within walking distance, so daily shopping is done on foot. Rent is moderate for Shinagawa Ward.
goodFor: People who want to do all their shopping on foot
People commuting to Shinagawa or central Tokyo
People who prefer a practical, lived-in neighborhood
notFor: People looking for a stylish neighborhood
People who want a large park nearby
People for whom quiet is the top priority
residentComment: This is a neighborhood organised around its shopping streets. Independent shops outnumber chains and fresh food is noticeably cheap. Low profile, but the kind of station where residents tend to stay.
